notes.title: 1.1 🍳 Culinary Update
notes.content: [h3]Meowllo![/h3][h3]A while back, we ran a poll in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/snackodev"]Discord[/url] on what we should work on next. A new cooking UI with the ability to make multiple of a dish at once won by a large margin. So, today, we bring you the humble...[/h3][p][/p][h1]🥗 What We've Been Cooking[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/446961cab29cb07df871a9860510b8284d85db40.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The new cooking system isn't just a new UI! We wanted to preserve the experimental aspect of it. If you haven't learned a recipe yet, you're free to try and make your best guess and see what comes out. Alongside the obvious quantity changer in the screenshot, here are the features:[/p][list][*][p][b]Experiment[/b] by throwing whatever you have in your rucksack or storages[/p][/*][*][p][b]Follow a recipe[/b] after browsing through your list[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]search[/b] bar for both your inventories and recipe list[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set the quantity[/b] and wait for it to cook while you continue on with your day[/p][/*][*][p]View the taste and type, as well as the restore values of each ingredient or dish[/p][/*][*][p]Preview how many of the recipe you can make with the ingredients available in your inventories[/p][/*][*][p]After selecting a recipe, relevant ingredients will be sorted to the front of the ingredient grid and marked with purple[/p][/*][*][p]Ingredients inside the pot will be marked with green[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/3e774931d41ebeaf780052d0b2ece1424dbdbafc.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🍋 When Life Gives You Lemons[/h1][list][*][p]New [b]Lemon Bush in the Desert Canyon[/b] have a chance to drop Lemons[/p][/*][*][p]Lemons can be used to make the new dishes: Mayonnaise, Lemon Pie, and Lemonade[/p][/*][*][p]Some old recipes, such as Catfish Sandwich and Fish 'n Chips now utilize these new ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Some foods that had missing attributes or underwhelming restore numbers have been fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/23268b6d9969c98f448f60cea4a8542c0a13ad8a.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🔖 Making Friends[/h1][list][*][p]Relationship gain from completing quests have been increased[/p][/*][*][p][b]Each NPC now has three friendship quests[/b]; these quests are marked with \[FE1], \[FE2], and so on[/p][/*][*][p][b]These will appear on the quest tree as well and show unlock requirements[/b]. The quest will let you know [b]where [/b]and [b]when[/b] to go[/p][/*][*][p]Each friendship quest shows a unique dialogue or cutscene to help you get to know your neighbors better[/p][/*][*][p]I hope you are able to deepen your bonds with the inhabitants of Snacko's world through these friendship quests![/p][/*][*][p]Some quests, such as Just a Hobby, have been re-parented to be introduced later in the game when more things are unlocked[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/40b90841c7ded8e9cf758c1417c85218fa2e2d25.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🐛 Misc. Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Cultural Center food displays that wouldn't let you know what should be in the display cases has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]You now unlock the [b]Clay Pot[/b] in the Blueprint Shop from completing [b]Tropical Getaway[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Watering farm tile related fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong weather icon when loading up your game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with unintentional fisheye effects on ultrawide resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]General UI and gamepad improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Interactables such as stoves and furnaces also show outline, not just storages[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll be making continued improvements to the cooking system and other consumable-related things over the next few weeks. Thank you for enjoying Snacko, we'll be back very soon with more updates ✨[/p][p][b]Thank you for reading~[/b][/p]

tags.feature: The new cooking system isn't just a new UI! We wanted to preserve the experimental aspect of it. If you haven't learned a recipe yet, you're free to try and make your best guess and see what comes out. Alongside the obvious quantity changer in the screenshot, here are the features:
Experiment by throwing whatever you have in your rucksack or storages
Follow a recipe after browsing through your list
A search bar for both your inventories and recipe list
Set the quantity and wait for it to cook while you continue on with your day
View the taste and type, as well as the restore values of each ingredient or dish
Preview how many of the recipe you can make with the ingredients available in your inventories
After selecting a recipe, relevant ingredients will be sorted to the front of the ingredient grid and marked with purple
Ingredients inside the pot will be marked with green
New Lemon Bush in the Desert Canyon have a chance to drop Lemons
Lemons can be used to make the new dishes: Mayonnaise, Lemon Pie, and Lemonade

notes.title: QoL Update 🌻 Donation Tracker & Relationship Gains
notes.content: [p]Meowllo![/p][p]Here's a little gift from us, a package of quality of life updates wrapped in a bow~[/p][h3]💖 Relationship Gains[/h3][list][*][p]Every time you gain friendship or heart points, it'll give you a notification[/p][/*][*][p]You now gain +2 points saying hello every day and another +5 talking to them again[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/5415032140e904c538b9ea854189792cd90af8b5.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]🪴 Donation Status Tracker[/h3][list][*][p]Donateable items will also show the stamp when you're hovering it in your rucksack[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/b249d6390b6b96a4a1b252114267200bce851374.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Items in the Cultural Center tracker will now display "???" instead of the item name, model, and description if you don't have the item or if you haven't donated it yet[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/f86e27d0e50d9defe9727e42ba1d7b19f889c47a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]We've listened to the feedback that part of the fun is discovering items as you play, so we hope this satisfies that desire![/p][/*][/list][h3]✨ Better Item Quality[/h3][list][*][p]We agree it's been too hard to see what quality an item is[/p][/*][*][p]Now, the icons are bigger, and the different levels are different colours[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/70d6c293d3f6c6b42b9b7353eee5c97dcfaa414c.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cloud Save Issues Update
notes.content: [h3]Meowllo![/h3][p]Since the dawn of time, Steam's Save Cloud has been occasionally messing with some player's save files. If you've experienced:[/p][list][*][p]Opening the game to realize you "lost" progress[/p][/*][*][p]Not being able to find the saves at all[/p][/*][/list][h3]We now have a solution![/h3][p][b]Each save now gets backed up locally to your device[/b], outside of the reach of Steam's Cloud Save system. If you find your saves out of date, make a backup of the folder just in case, and replace your Cloud Save files with the files inside the _LOCAL folder.[/p][p]Here, I made a picture... And wrote a step by step...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/4d860207e54debe19bf49c44959308384de4472a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Note: Only works if you can access the local files on your last played device[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]On your last played device, access the save files folder using [b]Windows Key + R[/b] and pasting in [b]%APPDATA%\\..\\Local\\snacko\\[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Inside the folder, access [b]Saved[/b] → [b]Save Games[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Number only folders (this is your Steam ID) are backed up via Cloud[/p][/*][*][p]If it has _LOCAL at the end, this is ONLY on your local device[/p][/*][*][p]Back up both folders, and copy in the save files from _LOCAL into the cloud folder[/p][/*][*][p]If your Cloud folder rolled back due to Cloud Saves error, replacing it with the LOCAL files will give you the most updated save on the device[/p][/*][/olist][p]As always, any problems you encounter with saves, [b]we do not delete or roll back save games with our updates[/b]. If you find this happening to you, and your Cloud Saves are disabled or you've replaced your files with LOCAL files, reach out and we can help get some of your items or progress back.[/p][p]Happy Snacko-ing[/p][p]...?[/p][p]Snackoing? Snacko time? Snack.[/p]

tags.bug: Each save now gets backed up locally to your device, outside of the reach of Steam's Cloud Save system.

notes.title: 1.0.1 💫 Achievements & Travel Portals
notes.content: [h3][b]Meowllo everyone![/b][/h3][p]Alongside the many smaller updates we've been putting out to address balance, stability, and other issues, we've also been working on completing achievements and adding in fast travel![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/66f7bde01825598e12fc6702c4458ffc228e7ec4.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🌟 Achievements[/h1][list][*][p][b]Achievements now come with rewards on completion[/b] - when you load up your save file, some of them may be auto-completed based on what you've done already![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]blueprint books[/b] [b]in shrines[/b] that used to house crafting recipes have now been moved to achievements. Much better, no?[/p][/*][*][p]Quests, logs, and achievements with unclaimed rewards will now show a [b]![/b] beside the journal tab when you open it up[/p][/*][*][p]There are [b]101 achievements in total[/b], so we hope you enjoy collecting all of them![/p][/*][*][p]There's a special [b]Star Trophy[/b] when you get all the achievements, so do your best~[/p][/*][*][p]Contests and events will now give a trophy instead of the Star Trophy; if you've obtained a Star Trophy from our building event from the past, it is now a Builder's Trophy[/p][/*][*][p]Completing all the [b]Cultural Center[/b] rooms will now reward you with a banner![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/1e27a6c2fe42b41a6b4aab1a83cac2047af0e41b.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]✈️ Fast Travel[/h1][list][*][p][b]Portals[/b] can be unlocked after completing the achievement [b]The Cat That Leapt Through Mines[/b] by resetting the mines layout ten times[/p][/*][*][p]The crafting recipe automatically crafts a set of them. You need to put two down and label them with the same name in order to fast travel between them[/p][/*][*][p]Once they are linked up, changing the name of one will [b]automatically change the other[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You [b]place Portals using the Builder's Kit[/b], so there are also no restrictions... Just remember: if you break the game on purpose, you deserve to enjoy the fruits of your labor. Player beware if you choose to get cheeky![/p][/*][*][p]You can place portals in different maps and indoors, including townhomes. [b]Townhome building areas have now been fixed[/b] and should properly display the items you've placed into them[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/95333d04be1c70f918e04e38fde7df8b7421388e.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🗃️ Misc.[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/a7a582005cd15564bf6f6ac36a8f97a945a1ee7f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Sigh... Fine. You guys win. [b]You can now eat Glue[/b]. It'll take away a bit of HP. Please don't eat glue irl.[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/9123bce5d505939b1c188e9be1bd9b6266752a03.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]For those who haven't booted up the game in a while, you can now view which storage container you're going to open. They will [b]highlight with an outline[/b]![/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/aecc53b3d026919028a094b74ab4901382910267.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Another feature we added a few small patches back is the ability to [b]search for crafting recipes[/b] in the work bench and crafting tab now! Huzzah![/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37705169/123cf36ac04ed4d6d62793b695e0df25376e1aa5.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hooray! We're finally at the end.[/b][/p][p]We really hope you enjoy the new achievements, they were tons of fun to think up and create.[/p][p]Don't forget, our Discord is full of friendly community members who will help you with any questions [strike]or bully me into making glue edible.[/strike] And of course, us, the devs, are always lurking as well.[/p][h3]See you next patch note! Meow meow meow 🐾[/h3][h2][url="https://discord.com/invite/snackodev" style="button"][b]Join our Discord[/b][/url][/h2]

tags.feature: Achievements now come with rewards on completion - when you load up your save file, some of them may be auto-completed based on what you've done already!
The blueprint books in shrines that used to house crafting recipes have now been moved to achievements.
Quests, logs, and achievements with unclaimed rewards will now show a ! beside the journal tab when you open it up
There are 101 achievements in total, so we hope you enjoy collecting all of them!
There's a special Star Trophy when you get all the achievements, so do your best~
Contests and events will now give a trophy instead of the Star Trophy; if you've obtained a Star Trophy from our building event from the past, it is now a Builder's Trophy
Completing all the Cultural Center rooms will now reward you with a banner!
Portals can be unlocked after completing the achievement The Cat That Leapt Through Mines by resetting the mines layout ten times
The crafting recipe automatically crafts a set of them.
You need to put two down and label them with the same name in order to fast travel between them
Once they are linked up, changing the name of one will automatically change the other

You place Portals using the Builder's Kit, so there are also no restrictions... Just remember: if you break the game on purpose, you deserve to enjoy the fruits of your labor. Player beware if you choose to get cheeky!

tags.bug: Townhome building areas have now been fixed and should properly display the items you've placed into them

tags.feature: You can now eat Glue. It'll take away a bit of HP.
For those who haven't booted up the game in a while, you can now view which storage container you're going to open. They will highlight with an outline!
Another feature we added a few small patches back is the ability to search for crafting recipes in the work bench and crafting tab now! Huzzah!

notes.title: 1.0.0_12004 - More balance and bugfixes!
notes.content:
Meowllo! You may have noticed a flurry of updates over the past few days, we've been hard at work polishing things up and taking all of your feedback and bug reports into account! 🥴

Here's the batch of updates that have been made since our last patch note:

⛏ Mines
- Clearing last layers of voxel piles will no longer cause you to sometimes fall through the floor
- Valuable resource rooms will now be guarded by slightly more enemy spawns
- Earth Slimes now heal amount 5 -> 10
- No more rain sounds while within the mine floor areas
- Earth Slime: HP 40 -> 130
- Mines buffs that affect stamina no longer apply outside of the mines
- "Curse" now increases enemy spawn rate as well as enemy drop rate, damage, and increases their overall HP
- Myst piles are guarded more frequently by enemies
- Myst piles show up less frequently on earlier floors
- Log machines now properly collide with the player
- Additional balancing work to make sure nothing is breaking the economy 🙂

🏎 Kart
- Fuel consumption gem effects/mines buffs now properly affect the drill's fuel consumption
- HOV Unit now can activate multiple times midair before it runs out (so you can let it go early/reboost)
- Added a speedometer to the fuel meter

😻 NPCs
- Fixed an issue where daily dialogue lines would keep repeating until you saved/loaded the game again
- Mack is now able to be confessed to
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to trigger two different heart/friendship events at the same exact time
- No longer stack on top of each other, and will walk away from each other if they get too close to one another

🌽 Farming
- Wheat is now able to be grown in the Spring season
- Watering Can now properly gives you an "out of water" message when you're out of water
- Harvest and Seed planting animations now allow you to move, and are much shorter in duration
- Sprinklers no longer block the harvest/seed planting actions

🪓 Resources
- "Phantom" resource issue has been fixed, you should no longer notice resources that stay in place after destroying them (trees, rocks, etc.)
- Perfect charging your tool hits should now deal 100% more resource damage

📕 Quests
- New Horizon: Fixed an issue where quest wouldn't complete properly for players, leaving them in a state where they could not progress with the other NPC roles (carpenter, etc)
- Maven of the Sea: Checking the letter set now properly gives you quest progress
- Maven of the Sea: Talking to ember properly finishes the quest
- Just a Hobby I: Fertilizer bags should now properly trigger quest task progression (duplicated Fertilizer Bag recipe has also been removed)
- Limitations Of Cardboard And Glue: Fixed an issue where the quest would not successfully register that you had a Carpenter on the island
- Happy Frame Salesman: Now awards the following crafting recipes that were previously unavailable (Consumables->Exploration)
	Tri-Flag Attachment
	Cat Set Attachment
	Dog Set Attachment
	Bunny Set Attachment
- XP rewards have been hidden (but are still tracked), as skills will come back in a later update!


🌙 Shrines
- The player's velocity no longer carries over between shrine restarts
- Stamina wheel now shows a cooldown bar when your mini-dash has been used
- Mini-dash is now a buffered input, so using it right before the cooldown ends will perform a mini-dash the moment the cooldown ends

✨ Staff
- Greatly reduced the required Stellar Zeals per spell level. 1/1/1/2/2/3/3/4/5, down from 3/5/7/10/13/16/20/24/30
- Chonkify: Added fading effect to visualize when effect is beginning to end
- Chonkify: Fixing issue where it was possible to grow larger than intended 😦

❓ Other
- Fixing issue where it was possible to open the builder kit UI while talking to Miss Curator, causing a softlock
- Player pin is no longer rotated by 90 degrees when in the Desert Canyon
- No longer possible to use sleeping boxes during cutscenes (such as finding the land sprite, etc); additionally, players who accidentally did this should no longer be softlocked in the quest progression


If you'd like more frequent updates on what's in each patch, I do create smaller patch notes for every build that goes live in our Discord server.

Coming up next is achievements - I'm excited to finally release these soon!

Thank you so much for playing our game, and for all the awesome feedback! 🥰

- recursive

notes.title: 1.0.0_11919 ⚖️ Balance, Mines, and Minimap
notes.content:
Meowllo! We have another round of fixes, polish, and drop rate balancing.
Thank you for all the feedback so far, we're still chewing through our list of polish and things to do, so thank you for your patience 💖

[h2]🚗 Kart[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fuel now recharges while you are in the kart,
[*] Drill now properly deactivates when you run out of fuel,
[*] Drill fuel consumption has been lowered slightly,
[/list]
[h2]⛏️ Mine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Holes should no longer be generating in layouts,
[*] Terminals should no longer be displaying the "Recipe" card when you've learned all available recipes,
[*] Voxel drops have been nerfed, again,
[*] Fixed a number of cases where resources within mine layouts would cause floating resources to spawn,
[*] Pickaxe and Gardening Hoe no longer consume incredible amounts of stamina when breaking voxels
[*] Bats and Flying Casters no longer drop infinite loot if you juggle them while they are dying,
[*] Music now properly changes as you descend through the mine floors,
[*] Fishing areas within the mine now properly spawn different kinds of fish as you descend,
[*] Myst Voxels now drop Crystal Clusters,
[*] Fixed an issue where ascending in the elevator from the ending floor would warp you to Floor 0 if you chose to go to lobby
[/list]
[h2]🗃️ Remnant Loom[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multiple drop rate/rarity calculation issues have been addressed! Certain items in the recipe were unable to be dropped, especially as your drop rate increased through buff usage,

notes.title: Snacko 1.0 ✨ Mines & Magicks Update
notes.content:
[h1]Meowllo and welcome to the Mines & Magicks update![/h1]

For those of you who have been playing since our early access launch in late 2023, thank you very much for sticking with us! The game has come such a long way and changed drastically.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IE7MGhQ.jpeg[/img]

There's more things we'd like to do, such as [b]multiplayer[/b], official [b]modding [/b]support, and [b]achievements[/b], but let's get into what [i]is[/i] new this patch, first!

[h2]🪜 Heading Down[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mine layouts can now be reset in the lobby or at the end. The layouts no longer randomize every time you sleep
[*] Each mine run is limited to ten floors
[*] Each floor has a variety of enemies, resources, and Terminals
[*] At each Terminal, you can select a random item, a random processor recipe, or a random buff
[*] Buffs are limited to inside the mines...until you upgrade them enough at the end of the run! Upgrade your buffs to have them persist even when you leave
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9safisp.gif[/img]
[h2]🚗 Getting Around[/h2]
[list]
[*] To aid your different runs through the mines, we have added an upgraded Kart and a Staff
[*] The Kart can now be accessed through the front to change out Modules, or the back to access the Trunk for storage
[*] You can increase your trunk capacity using BOX units, add a drill onto your Kart with a DIG unit, or even hover and fly with a HOV unit!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NK1IhPb.gif[/img]
[h2]⛈️ Extra Powers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Karts can now be [b]customized [/b]using Frames and Attachments to change the color or add on accessories
[*] The Staff can be used to cast up to [b]8 different spells[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V8JMZdh.gif[/img]
[*] Mix and match your two favorite spells and upgrade them with materials from the mine
[*] From chained lightning that bounces bolts between enemies to a self-buff that increases your size, play around with your favorite combo!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nYFfeOi.gif[/img]
[h2]⛏️ Yearning for the Mines[/h2]
[list]
[*] Once you've gathered up a bunch of materials from the mining nodes or enemies, you can take them to a Remnant Loom to process for even more stuff!
[*] Simply select a recipe and it'll automatically load in the materials. All you have to sit and watch...and wish for good luck
[*] All new questlines, Corps member logs, and crafting recipes to discover
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4EudTgI.gif[/img]
[h2]🪴 Other Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now [b]track Cultural Center donations[/b]. Sort by donated, undonated, or by category!
[*] You can now [b]place fish down as buildables[/b] to decorate with. The shark is um, large.
[*] An added vibrant world theme for those who miss the old days of brighter Snacko
[*] Added a short dash! You can now move around faster than ever, even without a Kart
[*] Double jump has been reworked to be less confusing: double jump anytime, anywhere! To revert back to the old jump, there's a legacy option in the settings
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AahqH7H.jpeg[/img]

These are the big notes for this patch!
We hope you'll find a lot of joy going through the new quests, learning the lore of the island, and exploring the mines with your new Kart and Solstice Staff.

There's a lot more coming, including Steam achievements and more!
Stay tuned and remember, we're always accessible through Discord. Questions? Bugs? Feedback? Ping us @Devs in chat! We'd love to chat with you.

See you soon, and thank you so, so sosososososso much for your unending support 💖

notes.title: 0.9.5_11127 🐟 Fishing balance, wallpaper dyes, and other fixes
notes.content:
Meowllo~
We are taking a few days break from 0.9.6 to work on some bug fixes and polish.

[h2]🎣 Fishing Changes[/h2]
Looking into some of the drop tables and sell values for fish, I realized that they were, uh, deeply imbalanced. Going through it all, I've made some sweeping changes that should address the feeling of certain fish feeling absolutely useless to catch while others felt overtuned in value for how rare and how early you were able to obtain them.

[b]Increases[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Catfish [/b]75 → 80
[*] [b]Haddock [/b]75 → 180
[*] [b]Betta [/b]50 → 200
[*] [b]Tilapia [/b]90 → 750
[*] [b]Squid [/b]4,800 → 7,800
[*] [b]Mystfish [/b]9,800 → 10,000
[/list]
[b]Decreases[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Softshell Turtle[/b] 320 → 150
[*] [b]Clownfish [/b]480 → 230
[*] [b]Guppy [/b]400 → 240
[*] [b]Angelfish [/b]560 → 300
[*] [b]Koi [/b]780 → 320
[*][b] Fire Goby[/b] 460 → 340
[*] [b]Crawfish [/b]500 → 400
[*] [b]Tuna [/b]2,800 → 2,200
[*] [b]Great White Shark[/b] 8,900 → 8,500
[/list]
Some of the factors that contribute to these changes include their spawn rate, which biome they appear in first, and how important money is at that point in the MSQ.
For example, the selling price of Haddock was greatly increased to match the change in which they were removed from the town spawn pool, and now mostly found in the Mushroom Forest and beyond.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ga09EdE.jpeg[/img]

[b]Spawn Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased spawn rate of Catfish and Tuna in farm and town
[*] Removed spawn of Haddock, Angelfish, Sea Bass and Betta in farm and town
[*] Decreased spawn rate of Softshell Turtle and Crawfish in Plains
[*] Added Sea Bass an Fire Goby to Desert
[*] Added and increased spawn rate of Haddock in Forest and Tundra
[*] Increased spawn rate of Salmon in Tundra
[/list]
Hopefully, with the value changes along with the spawn changes, there will feel like there's more of a progression with the different fish you can find as you go through the game, instead of having too many fish varieties available in the beginning, causing the game to feel stale when you discover new bodies of water.

[h2]⛏️ Mines (Legacy)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed glitchy elevator audio that wouldn't stop in some cases
[*] Increased resource health to prevent some things from dying too easily
[*] Fish now appear based on which floor you're on (1/2, 3/4, and 5)
[/list]
[h2]📐 Builder Kit[/h2]
Floors and Wall dye experience has been improved
[list]
[*] Previewing no longer breaks the state of the wall/floor and will properly revert itself
[*] Dyes should now properly consume and reflect in the UI
[/list]
[h2]✨ Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] 0.9.6 death animation has been added (when you die, how sad)
[*] Fire Goby properly added to Desert Canyon's saltwater spawn table
[*] Quest board no longer re-focuses onto "reoccuring" tab after accepting a card
[*] Fixed issue where the quest "Reel Improvement" couldn't be completed if you had already upgraded your rod at least once
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.5_10693 🍜 QoL: Cooking, Resource Respawn + Mines Update Teaser
notes.content:
Meowllo, everyone! How's your new year so far?
We've been quiet for a bit lately, working hard on 0.9.6: Mines Update. So, I've come here today with a sneak peek at something new, plus some quality of life additions and changes.

[h2]✨ Changes & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lunchbox now only consumes ONE item[/b] on stamina or HP depletion instead of filling to full
[*] You can now toggle [b]resource respawn [/b]for town and/or farm under Settings - Tweaks
[*] You can now [b]empty items from a stove[/b] or cooking station if you put in the wrong items
[*] You can now cook the previously made recipe using a hotkey
[*] You can now skip the cooking animation
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YZD8fER.jpeg[/img]

[h2]🐛 Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixing issue where some prizes from pinball machine would not be deposited into your inventory
[*] Removing special items and high value items from pinball rewards
[*] Fixed issue where you could see the secondary interact prompt on crops
[*] Fixed issue where completing "Hardly Difficult" did not properly unlock the Floor Cushion in the Blueprint Shop
[/list]

[h2]📝 What We've Been Working On...[/h2]
And...that's all for the live changes!
Huh? What's this? I was handed a flyer...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jSqpPl4.jpeg[/img]

With 0.9.6 also comes the ability to dive into the story behind Snacko Island and the mysterious mines. What was project MX18? Was the curse really enacted by the Goddess? What about all this tech that you don't remember seeing back in Capital City?

While exploring the mines, you'll be able to discover some answers to your questions. With your trusty, updated Kart, you'll be able to swap out the frame or use dyes. The Kart will also come with components you can craft and slot into it, including adding storage that you can take with you on the go.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YSXrkN4.gif[/img]

You'll be able to jump out of your Kart and mess with the configuration under the hood to add accessories, change the frame color, or add components to unlock features.

How exciting!
Okay, that's all the info you get for now. Back to the mines! (hahahahahaha)

notes.content:
Meowllo!
We have come to present you with another quality of life update. This will likely be our last bigger update as we head back into the mines to work on 0.9.6.

Without further ado, let's get into the changes this patch!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zqqJASw.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Auto-swing for tools[/b] is now an option under gameplay. You won't be able to perfect charge, but you can toggle this option on to hold down the tool use button
[*] [b]Auto-advance dialogue[/b] is now an option under gameplay. You can also toggle this on during a dialogue sequence. The controls for the toggle can be found on the upper right hand corner
[*] [b]Hotkey for quest log[/b] added. By default, this is clicking in the right stick of a gamepad or U on keyboard. You can rebind this in the settings
[*] [b]Lock storage containers[/b] using the lock button beside the storage container name. This will prevent you from using the items inside while crafting or placing
[*] You can now [b]enter build mode if you're hovering a buildable in your hotbar[/b] using the same hotkey or button to eat
[/list]

The[url=https://snacko.wiki.gg/wiki/Characters#Shopkeeper_NPCs] wiki has also been updated[/url] so it's accurate when checking how to unlock certain shopkeepers or villagers.

We have some fun stuff planned coming up, so thank you for your patience as we put our heads back down and focus on our next major update!

notes.title: 0.9.5_10572 🌨️ Tooltips & quality-of-life changes
notes.content:
[b]Meowllo! Happy holidays~[/b]
Both recursive and I have sent you a letter in-game with a little present to celebrate one year of Snacko and the holidays!

Along with that, we've also added some quality of life things and changes...

[h3]❗ Tool Tips[/h3]
There's...a lot of small things in Snacko that can be overwhelming at first. Reading pages of tutorials isn't everyone's favorite way of digesting information, either.
To aid with this, we've added [b]tooltips on hover[/b] on some elements in the UI.
You can turn off this new feature under "gameplay" in settings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fdUowZZ.png[/img]

[h3]📬 Invite ___ Quests[/h3]
We noticed that a lot of players don't realize you can invite carpenters and alchemists early on in the game, so we've added quests to help guide you in that direction. For those that already have the shopkeepers on your island, you can claim the rewards for these new requests on your save file load
[list]
[*] Limitations of Cardboard and Glue (carpenter)
[*] Just Like Magic (alchemist)
[*] Expanding Horizon (villager)
[*] Ordering Out (restaurateur)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SWR04s5.png[/img]

[h3]☕ Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Barns no longer have a capped place limit of four.[/b] You can place as many as you want. Whether or not having 99 chickens can do something unexpected in the game... Well, we'll cross that bridge when we get there
[*] [b]Storage and journal notes font have changed to a monospace font[/b]. This is personal preference. I like writing down my plans in my journal for each Obelisk and what I want to offer, and having the letters after my - or X not line up when I cross off an item was making me sad
[*] Maximum zoom for camera has been increased. For this change, we've reset everyone's camera zoom level back to the default. You can change this again under "gameplay" in the settings
[/list]

Hooray! We hope this makes the early game transition into mid game feel smoother.
Thank you everyone for your support and your feedback, we'll keep working hard 🫶

notes.title: 0.9.5_10497 🗺️ Updated Map UI
notes.content:
Hooray!
So, I played my own file for a few hours yesterday, and tried thinking about what kind of improvements or polish we could do quickly before the start of the Winter Sale.

And we agreed to settle on...
[h3]The map![/h3]

The map, for the longest time, wasn't too useful. Sure, I guess it told you which way the Grassy Plains were, but that's about it.

So, drum roll please...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CH0N18g.gif[/img]
[b]Ta-da~![/b]
It's also set up better now for us to add more to it in the future when we work on the major updates.

With this map you can...
[list]
[*] view villager relationships and if you've given them a gift today
[*] view shop and house names, as well as their opening hours
[*] view barn and livestock names
[*] see where the fishing spots are (yellow fish are freshwater spots, blue fish are saltwater spots)
[*] see where points of interest or warp zones to other areas
[/list]
The mini-map is also updated to be the same as the main map. Some maps, like the Desert Canyon, should match your position on the map much better now as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5kmhaLe.jpeg[/img]

We hope this helps new and returning players alike.
We did sort of um, kind of cram this map into 24 hours of work...so both of us kinda need to go chill out for a day now. Then, it's back to work on the mines.

[h3]📬 Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with crafting dropdown not being full width
[*] Fixed issue with inconsistent lighting when dropped items get picked up
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes, the sprite could get in the way of your watering...
[*] Fixed issue where you couldn't go through the side door of your barn
[/list]
Thank you very much for your support~ And don't forget, we'll be [b]20% off from today until January 2nd[/b]! If you have been enjoying Snacko, don't forget to leave us a review and tell your friends about us!

Stay warm 🐾
...Or cool, depending on which side of the equator you are on.

notes.title: 0.9.5_10190 🎉 Snacko Roadmap Update + 1 Year Annivesary
notes.content:
[b]Meowllo everyone![/b]
Last year, on December 6th, we finally launched Snacko into Early Access!
Recursive and I have been working on this game since...2019. So, it's been a long...long...longgg journey.

Before I get into the patch notes, let's take a look at our roadmap first...

[h2]🗺️ Snacko Roadmap to 1.0[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ojBf89u.jpeg[/img]

We are planning to do four major updates before 1.0

We're currently working on overhauling the mine system. It'll be a lot different than how it is currently, with the layouts more conductive to Snacko's current gameplay and mechanics that has more room for movement mechanics and zoomed out camera use.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y55rP3N.jpeg[/img]

We're still in the early stages, but here's a sneak peak and what we've been slowly designing and cooking up for 0.9.6! If you're curious, we always post little snippets of what we're working on occasionally in [url=https://discord.com/invite/snackodev][b]Discord[/b][/url]. Not as official updates or anything, just casual messages! So, feel free to join and chat. We have an amazing community 🫶

Like always, between each major update, we'll continue to update the game with smaller updates, bug fixes, optimizations, and quality of life improvements.

[h2]📬 Changes[/h2]
[h3]🛒 Item Drop Optimizations[/h3]
Those who like to resource gather may have noticed that clearing large swathes of foliage with your sword can slow your game down over time. Sometimes, it can eventually crash your game!

But have no fear, recursive has optimized them...to a scary extent. We hope this makes your lawnmower (sword) and bomb arrow experience much more fun when out collecting goodies.

[h3]😺 Giant Bibbles Plush[/h3]
Since you guys asked so nicely, you can now obtain a Giant Bibbles Plush. It requires three Stuffed Nobu Jr.'s to craft, but you'll get one as a reward early on for completing "A Curious Cat".

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MEIwi0V.gif[/img]

[h3]📦 Storage Containers[/h3]
You can now [b]name storage containers[/b] and they will pop up as you approach them. If you have items inside already, pressing the "hold" button while near it will [b]auto-deposit the ones in your rucksack[/b] into that storage container.

[h2]🥂 Thank You![/h2]
I think for both of us, the past year has been one of the hardest for us, both physically working on it daily and mentally. It's taken a toll on us, but we're finally closer to the end than we are to the beginning.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ab6uRUG.jpeg[/img]

This is a screenshot from 2019, when we first started working on Snacko. Back then, you had to walk around to preview buildables, and it was tile-based placement. You couldn't do half tiles, or free rotate, or stacking. It was pretty limited...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3X649Fz.jpeg[/img]

It's kind of crazy to look back through what is nearly five years worth of almost daily work to see the build mode in what it is today...all with gamepad support, too!

It's one of those things that feels and seems impossible to do, but we chipped at it slowly, and now we have Snacko in its current form. Every time someone makes a post on social media or says something in Discord, it reminds us that people do play the game, and they enjoy it!

That's crazy!!!

It can get tough being holed up in our rooms just working all the time. The pressure of continually delivering on the new patches, making sure we don't break old save files, testing the game, and figuring out how to keep our bills paid... It's been really hard on us, but we're almost there.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gxU3pw6.jpeg[/img]

Thank you so much for the support you've given us, no matter when you joined the community!
Please consider sharing us with your friends! It helps us out a lot 👉👈

[h3]So for a quick rundown of what we've done since our EA release...[/h3]
[list]
[*] New UI with expanded dark mode
[*] World themes to change the look of the game
[*] Progression rebalancing and redesign to better pace the story
[*] Quest system with new UI, storylines, and over 50+ newly written quests
[*] Build mode upgrades
[*] Better gamepad support and routing + Steam Deck support
[*] Start of a character customization system
[*] Ability to expand your house to add more rooms and change the wallpaper and flooring
[*] New crafting recipes and placeable items
[*] Blueprint shop to better pace item unlocks
[*] New movement tech including sword dashing, double jumping, and pickaxe bouncing with smoother controls
[*] Tool upgrades that add different effects to existing tools, like spread shot arrows
[*] Ability to send and receive items from other players...completely offline!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JcDirb1.jpeg[/img]

There's tons of other smaller things, but that covers the big ones we've pushed out since last December.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NtykIO9.jpeg[/img]

That's [b]269 [/b]patches we've put out...and counting! Thank you to everyone who has played, reported a bug, posted a screenshot, chatted, talked about us...honestly, anything!

[h3]Thank you for our first year on Steam, let's have a great 2025! 💖[/h3]
[b]- with love, enralis & recursive[/b]

notes.title: Builder's Dream MAJOR Update 📐✨
notes.content:
Meowllo! It's been a while!! Because we couldn't make any hotfix patches while swapping out with our fancy new Builder's Kit.

There's a lot of new features of quality of life things to go through, so let's just go straight into it. More GIFs, less yapping from me. Yippe!!

[h1]Builder's Kit Overview[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EBNF4e0.gif[/img]
[h2]🔖 UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ability to search for items
[*] Categories with pages...and the pages save! If you're on page 3 while exiting, you will come back to page 3
[*] Ability to favorite items to easily access them through your favorites tab
[*] Shows how many you own and how many you are able to craft
[*] Like all of Snacko's UI, the new Builder's Kit catalog also has a dark mode.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fU0pRRM.jpeg[/img]
[h2]✨ New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multi-select same buildables to mass dye
[*] Able to preview dyes and dyes are now shown as swatches in the dye menu
[*] When you switch dye colors, it will refund your previous dye
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/daiDNIs.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Multi-select items while holding down a key + hovering over them to move, adjust, or put away
[*] You can now select foliage that you've planted, like trees or flowers, to move them
[*] When pressing down on your middle mouse button or clicking in your controller's right stick while hovering a buildable, it'll let you place that buildable (eyedropper tool)
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BHy3toE.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now craft directly while placing things in build mode. It'll show you how many materials you have and how many you need
[*] It'll read your items from your rucksack, storage containers, and your overflow storage as well
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qi0KPAz.jpeg[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now place buildables anywhere, including out of bounds, in other maps, and inside NPC houses
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AlpYqMI.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Buildables no longer have collision restrictions. You can now put objects as close together as you like, or clip them together using the new "Nudge" feature
[*] "Locking" an item puts you into nudge mode. While nudging, you can raise or lower objects, as well as shift them around
[*] You can use this to clip objects into each other or float them
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qg7HTV3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Buildables placed on top of each other will now get parented properly
[*] Selecting a buildable will highlight and select any buildables on it
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l0GWFMK.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] You can combine this with nudge to easily parent buildables to a foundation to make moving your creations around easier
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xvIP8Zv.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] When moving multiple objects, they will try to snap to surfaces
[*] Locking while moving will snap them to the first selected buildable's height
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eepgcNk.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Fences now preview the connection while moving or placing
[*] Fences can now slant their connection for slopes or platforms
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JlHAWlG.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] You can [b]undo and redo actions[/b]: place, put away, move, and dye
[*] The undo and redo queue is saved and only refreshed when you change the map, reload, or place a required buildable for a quest
[*] You can turn on screenshot mode and use this as a way to record a timelapse of your builds!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0VzWOjy.gif[/img]

[h1]New Content & Changes[/h1]

[h2]🖼️ New Quests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Paintings have been removed as chest items in the overworld and replaced with materials
[*] You can now obtain paintings through quests, starting with [b]Catching a Glimpse[/b], available after Charity Work and MSQ Follow the Sign
[*] Completing these quests will also teach you the crafting recipe for them, allowing you to place them as decorations after donating one to the Cultural Center
[*] The new quests also contain side story content
[*] 6 quests added: Catching a Glimpse, Painting Jumpscare, Doppelganger, Frame of Time, Path of the Pious, and Artistic Surprise
[/list]
[h2]📬 Quest Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quests that ask you to invite all villagers or shopkeepers of a certain type have been re-parented to quests that are later in the game to prevent them from showing up too early
[*] If you had them accepted but not completed, they'll be returned to the board or unavailable until you complete all the prerequisites
[*] Tutorial days now properly teaches players how to claim quest rewards
[*] Small Workbench has been moved to D.I.Why and taken out of tutorial days
[/list]
[h2]🔭 Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New grass texture
[*] Added cloud shadows to the world
[*] Changed "Block" type buildables to have a subtle texture
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GOEK9Zf.jpeg[/img]

[h2]🐛 Fixes & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Floating ominous orb in the title screen by Mikan's house now gone
[*] Flowers now drop 1 Plant Material with a 15% chance of dropping 2 as the new Builder Kit makes it easy to mass-craft and plant flowers, giving you too much of a net positive of stamina and materials
[*] Available paintings now have sell values
[*] Crafting tab no longer lags; only contains crafting recipes for consumables and materials. Traditional buildables can be crafted or pinned from your Builder's Kit
[*] Cows and chickens no longer yap so frequently and less loud
[*] Removed all building restrictions except for barns and NPC houses
[*] Fixed issues with building inside townhomes
[*] The grid now properly aligns with the corners of the house, allowing you to place blocks, counters, or tables to snap to the edge properly
[*] Guardians now have their own text style
[*] Optimization of buildables, especially in save files with 20,000 blocks
[/list]

...Wow, did I get everything? I think so!
The text overlay when you're in nudge mode used to be "locked". But then, I made a joke image while working on the new tutorial images and...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SCwO7ea.jpeg[/img]

There's a lot of features packed into this update, and it should make building a lot smoother and feel a lot better. You can really go all out making different kinds of things, like a Pumpkin-headed Nobu Jr Plush, or something more normal.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fbhV3WP.jpeg[/img]

Which new feature are you the happiest about? I think for me, it's the undo and redo. I make mistakes a lot, so it's a lifesaver. I still have a slight bit of panic when I accidentally put things away, but now I remember I can just ctrl+Z my problems away.

If you read this all the way to the end (or you just scrolled here hi), thank you very much! The two of us need to go take a nap now~ ...and buy groceries.

[h3]As always, thank you very much for your support 🥺 We put a lot of work and polish into this update!

If you have any questions, [url=https://discord.gg/snackodev]feel free to ping us in Discord.[/url]
See you soon 🐾[/h3]

notes.title: 0.9.4_9576 🎃 Spooky Update + Sale! New Items & Quests
notes.content:
[h3]Celebrate Lunarfall by learning about the customs and history through new quests and decorate your town and home with new items crafted with the new Pumpkin crop![/h3]

[b]Snacko is on sale for 20% off for the duration of Lunarfall, from October 24th to November 7th[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NCbJJlu.jpeg[/img]

In the next few days, we'll be running a small building contest with the new items. For those who aren't that far along to get all the new things, a save file will be provided with the items to play around with. Keep your eyes peeled for that announcement~

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UW01ohv.png[/img]

[h2]✨ New[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Vintage Set has been updated to be completely dyeable[/b]. Now, not only are the usual dyeable parts customizable, so are the wood trims.
[*] [story] [b]Precipice of the Moon[/b]: prerequisite for Pumpkin items, requires MSQ to be completed until post "Two Eyes for Nothing"
[*] [story] [b]Old Traditions, New Decorations[/b]: unlocks Pumpkin Lanterns
[*] [story] [b]Ghost in the Squash[/b]: unlocks Pumpkin Scarecrow, requires MSQ to be completed
[*] [b]Gourd at Work[/b]: unlocks Pumpkin Seeds
[*] [b]Squashed Hopes[/b]: prerequisite for Pumpkin recipes
[*] [b]Sugar, Spice, and I Forgot[/b]: unlocks Pumpkin Pie, Pumpkin Porridge, and Pumpkin Spice Latte
[*] [b]De-fenceless[/b]: unlocks Ornate Fence, requires Frozen Tundra materials
[/list]

[h2]📬 Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Grilled Mushroom[/b] HP restore was a little high for how early you can learn and get the materials for the recipe. Heart Restore: 2 → 1.5
[*] Changes to tool movement to make pickax bounce feel better and trigger less when you're just hitting things
[/list]

[h2]🗣️ enraliYapping[/h2]
I didn't want to really call it "Halloween" inside the game since that's sort of based in real-world belief systems that don't exist in Snacko. After all, Snacko has their own beliefs and deities already well established in the lore...so I figured it deserved its own version of "Halloween". Keeping the idea the same where it's helping souls move past purgatory, Lunarfall is just the more, um, Snacko version of it.

I had a lot of fun writing the banter between the characters for these new quests, including the quest descriptions. As time goes on and more Guild quests get added, the Guild leaders or reps also end up getting more of their own personality that makes them easier to write more interesting descriptions for.

So, I hope if quests and reading are your thing, you enjoy the work I've put into the narrative aspect of this update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2d9F4KF.gif[/img]

Ah, and, I was going to do Pumpkin Soup at first, but then I realized it looked exactly like Carrot Soup... So I made hobakjuk instead. It's a type of pumpkin soup thickened with rice flour and rice balls. Honestly, working on this update just made me really want to eat pumpkin pie. Maybe I can get my hands on some soon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ebu2NFD.jpeg[/img]

The Ornate Fence is set up in a way that in the future, we can make it dyeable. We're still working on our next major update with the build mode upgrades, so for everyone who really enjoys getting creative, please look forward to it! 🙇

[b]Thank you very much for reading! Happy Lunarfall![/b]

notes.title: Demo Update & Updates Coming Up ✨
notes.content:
Meowllo!

The demo will finally have parity with our current 0.9.4 version. Up until now, demo players were still experiencing the old UI and lack of new game settings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQw2B5J.gif[/img]

I went back to check just how out of date the demo is, and it doesn't even have the dark mode UI toggle in the beginning of the game!

...Yeah, it was a lot of work porting the 0.9.4 update to the demo version since locking the game was completely different.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vbKoCmS.jpeg[/img]

Now, demo players can also get experience a bit of what the quest system is like and the overall game flow in the first few days. Sorry it took us so long 🙇

The limitations are similar, the main demo (game preview with tutorial days) ends on day six, or if you reach the "Them Apples" cutscene, whichever comes first.

In sandbox mode, it ends when you reach the next day.

As for existing players, we are working on our next major update: 0.9.5 will mainly deal with a lot of building QoL as well as build mode in general.

For something that is closer on the horizon, I've been working on a small Halloween-ish update. It'll come with quests, a new crop, a few recipes, and some furniture. So please look forward to that!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zt2OROi.jpeg[/img]

Honestly, our thought was "we should quickly update the demo!" and we thought it would take, you know, like a day? But we ended up running into some issues, and it ended up being more like three. In the process, we ironed out some bugs, like character customization not saving on intro skip in the main game, so that's good!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fOW6jsT.jpeg[/img]

We did lose our minds a little bit, though.

notes.title: 0.9.4_9376 🌲 Building Materials Quest Changes & New Quest
notes.content:
Meowllo!
I realized that you used to be able to purchase all the wall panels (Softwood, Drywall, etc.) from the get-go, including things like Nails and Concrete Slab.

Short of it:
[list]
[*] Building Materials now split into three: the first now able to be taken and completed before the Grassy Plain's Obelisk completion
[*] You now have to buy the wall panels, concrete slab, etc. from the blueprint shop. If you've already learned these recipes, this doesn't affect you
[*] You'll only get access to the wall panels now as you unlock the ability to get the raw materials for them
[*] New questline Futures Market added for those farther along. Requires Kiryl and finishing up to Building Materials III (Desert Canyon completion)
[/list]

After some things were changed into quests, you were no longer able to easily get the 20 Concrete Slabs required for the Obelisk unless you got lucky breaking down debris.

Building Material has been changed to Building Material I, the first of three quests, and is immediately unlocked after "Intro to the Carpenter's Guild", making it now possible to purchase the Concrete Slab recipe before you unlock the mines.

Instead of the recipes being directly taught, they now cost money in the shop. My intention with money in the early game should be that you feel the need to consider whether to hold onto items or sell them, instead of just simply hoarding everything you come across because currency currently holds little value outside of buying seeds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aN1Aeig.jpeg[/img]

Instead of one quest giving you access to all the wall panels, Building Material II and III will now incrementally add the different wall panels and framing to your shop, making it align better with where you are in the MSQ and whether or not you can even obtain the raw materials.

Included now in the quest are tasks that are soft ways of teaching you how to get materials, such as Building Material I letting you know Glue is made from putting Birch or Toasted Birch Wood into a furnace.

Once those are completed, along with some other quests, there is a new quest for those farther along in the game: Futures Market. It's a continuation of some of the world lore covered in Digging Through the Archives. While working on this, since I wanted the quest to branch off based on what you pick, I noticed a bug that also affected some other quests, which explains why sometimes Two Eyes for Nothing would not completely properly for some players. Sorry;; I have fixed!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZgSTNhG.jpeg[/img]

It'll set things up nicely for future quests and story bits I'd like to integrate into our mines update, so look forward to that!

notes.title: 0.9.4_9243 🔖 RNG drop table pity, quest clean up, and new early game quests
notes.content:
Meowllo!

It's here...pity system for Snacko drops. Are you tired of farming for a rare item over and over again? Flipping the coin 1,000 times just to get unlucky?

We tested our drop rates, and statistically, they were working. But boy does it feel terrible to lose out on apples and gems after grinding all day.

So recursive implemented a pity system. Or bad luck protection, if you don't play gacha games.

If you're going for a rare item over and over again, it will slowly become more common until you get it, and then the drop rates reset.

As for the quests...

Is it confusing if you've went through the Carpenter's Guild quests quickly, then was asked for glass before you've even unlocked the area to get the Cobalt you needed?

...Yeah.
I've done some quest clean up to help the quest board feel less cluttered right off the bat.

D.I.Why was also a product of it's time: back when we didn't have an easy way to create multiple quests, so it just taught you like...40 things. We've now moved them off into separate quests that are new. If you already have these items unlocked, it's okay! You can still do them.


[h3]✨ New Quests[/h3]
- Light It Up teaches torches
- Better Than a Bed teaches Sleeping Box
- Back to Plain teaches Original Dye
- Someone's Garbage... teaches the debris crafting recipes from D.I.Why

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7bIM4OF.jpeg[/img]

[h3]📬 Quest Changes[/h3]
- Way of the Weapons I (teaches sword) now available after Them Apples to learn early on
- Fool Me Once, Modern Taste, Tropical Getaway, Mushroom Mayhem, Vintage Variety now require you to unlock the biomes with the materials required before the quests appear
- Sow What III now requires Iva's quest Negotiation Tactics to be completed since it requires Spinach
- Just a Hobby III now requires Sow What II since it requires Wheat
- D.I.Why now teaches the recipes on reward claim like Fishing for Compliments to be less confusing
- Fixed Tameem's Troubles not completing properly when delivering Glue (in the back end, it was asking for glass...)

Moving forward, you'll see more changes like this slowly as we try to reduce the bulk of 100 quests being added to your board at once, while keeping in mind the frustration that can happen if things are locked behind too far into mid-late game.

Thank you very much for playing~

notes.title: 0.9.4 Town and Guild update is here! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]YESSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS WE’RE FINALLYYYYYY DONEEEEEEE (asterisk kind of asterisk).[/h2]

This is the biggest patch we’ve done since early access launch and it absolutely, irrevocably, mentally broke the two of us. We prefer to do smaller patches more frequently, but this patch just required so much tech debt to be fixed and systems to be remade there was no other way we could’ve done this.

Well, it’s almost over now. We’re still going to be working on some polish and adding some content that we couldn’t put in (like join quests), but for now, we both really, really need a day off after two and a half months of non-stop work.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FWcOCHZ.png[/img]

It’s been so long I’m starting to make really dumb mistakes, so yeah…a day off would be nice…………

There’s a lot of ground to cover, so before I begin, I’m just going to list out the categories and highlight the major changes.
[list]
[*] Restrictions on villagers lifted: you can now have everyone all at once!
[*] Blueprint shop and other recipes no longer all unlocked at the beginning. All new quests have been implemented to unlock content
[*] Villager quests have been completely redone and new ones have been added
[*] Villager dialogue pools have been reworked to give better chances of seeing all the lines; certain lines that don’t make sense to be repeated as you befriend them will no longer be in the pool (ex: Rejka being confused why you’re talking to him in the morning despite the two of you dating)
[*] While saves are compatible, we had to auto-complete some new quests to keep your progression state into 0.9.4; you will also have everything unlocked inside the blueprint shop already
[*] UI changes for expanded dark mode, including an all new quest system and UI to go along with it
[*] Crafting recipes can be tracked alongside a quest on your HUD via the crafting menu or a workbench
[/list]

Okay, now that the main points are out of the way, it’s time for enraliYapping! ☝️🤓

[h1]🔖 Quest Progression[/h1]
Gone are the days of MIAO unlocking everything. From now on, MIAO will serve as a gentle nudge for players to discover features about the game, as well as progressing through Mikan’s character arc. I’d like to add some more quests in the near future so you can get to know her own journey through Snacko Island’s revival.

To highlight how much has been changed, areas in yellow are quests that were retained from 0.9.3, everything outside of that I made for 0.9.3:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XlrOFgC.jpeg[/img]

Yeah…it was a lot…….That’s why it took us forever to test and fix :(

But! I’m really excited to see how you feel about the new progression. Instead of having 300 recipes unlocked right off the bat, anything from dyes, to cooking recipes, to crafting recipes can now be unlocked in a variety of ways, usually through Guild quests.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2vCTqVE.jpeg[/img]

Guilds each have their own representative(s) that will communicate with you through quests or deliveries. Each Guild rep sort of has their own personality and way of writing, and some of them even have mini story arcs within them, so I hope you enjoy getting to know everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Iqivw1g.jpeg[/img]

You can also unlock things via villager quests. Not only will you learn a new recipe or unlock a new shop item, you’ll also get to know them better! It’s a win-win!

We want to slowly move away from the whole “talk to NPC, give them gift, rinse repeat” cycle, as well as the “randomly trigger their friendship event when walking around”. With the quest system, we’re hoping to slowly port over those cutscenes, as well as giving players new ways to gain relationship points with the characters.

There are also changes to the quest tracker on your screen!

Now, the quest no longer disappears immediately after finishing, causing confusion. It will now stay on the HUD until you switch maps, or when you get a new quest, or when you track a different quest.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uMSlV0H.jpeg[/img]

Completed quests with rewards will require you to claim these rewards. There’s a new filter inside your journal to view unclaimed rewards, as well as an animation and icon in the quest tree.

You may also find quests that have rewards on accept. Those will be denoted with a little golden ticket icon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1rOL5Lc.jpeg[/img]

The quest tree itself was built in our back end SnackoEd tool on the web, and the locations of each node are then ported over into the game. Cool, right? If we were still using the old quest system, there would’ve been no way I could’ve made all these new quests for this update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W1ytOAR.jpeg[/img]

Along with the new quests also come new quest types. So, instead of just shipping something, or getting X number of items, there are also quests from villagers that will request you to place decorations or other buildables near their house.

It was a lot of work to rip out all the guts, from the way the game faded to the way the HUD rendered…but it was worth it! Snacko needed to get changed at one point so we could scale more easily, so we’re glad we bit the bullet.

Let’s all give recursive a round of applause for sacrificing their sanity! Yippee!

[h1]📝 Coming Soon[/h1]
In the next couple of days, outside of fixing any nasty bugs, we’ll also be finishing up “join” type quests. These are quests that you can grab from the board and meet up with the villager and go on an adventure together! They’ll follow you around until you bring them home, so it’s a nice way to spend some time with your favourites.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PsAqp5P.gif[/img]

For now, they’re disabled until we push that update, so you may find some “coming soon” cards in your tree or board.

You may have also noticed some quests being labelled as “story”. There’s currently two side story quests after you finish the main story, but I’d love to add more. In preparation for these, I’ve moved off a lot of the front-loaded exposition in the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kTB8sbI.jpeg[/img]

One thing I’ve noticed is that players actually continue to read the journals spread out through the biomes. I wasn’t expecting that… So, I wanted to do something like that without just littering books everywhere. Story quests will be a continuation of that concept, where the burden of world building and lore is no longer stuffed into the mandatory main story cutscenes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GKIqV4u.jpeg[/img]

The bookshelf/tutorial UI was also updated into SnackoUI, and I’ve left myself some room and space in the data for adding notes and books you can find in the future for more lore-dumps.

Now that I’ve talked about some of the things that we had to set up the game’s systems for in the near future, let’s go back to what’s already in the game…

[h1]📐 U and I[/h1]
You may have noticed some big changes in the UI! Now, with expanded dark mode, it’s no longer just the dialogue box.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VagX4Jo.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Original[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RVD7DEZ.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Darker[/h3]

There’s some improvements as well, such as the action prompt image now paired with the item indicator, instead of needing the item name to disappear before you can see which key it is.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ceJNhIy.jpeg[/img]

The dialogue boxes and choices themselves also got a face lift, along with new animations and functionality. When you’re speaking to a villager about a quest, it should show the quest name on the upper right corner.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QXCt05E.jpeg[/img]

The dialogue system was rewritten as a system so we can better add new lines in the future. The old system was…prohibitive, to say the least, and it did not scale well. With these new system-level changes, we hope localization and adding more content in the future will be 100 times easier!

I mean, just look at this… I don’t want to touch this…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/I9Vzmyj.jpeg[/img]

Now, we can use a bunch of different ways to get text into the game. Either that’s through our custom back end SnackoEd, or through a good ol’ spreadsheet.

Hehe, there’s a lot, and honestly, I’ve forgotten a lot of the polish we’ve done since it’s been two months since we started. So I hope you guys will enjoy the little touches!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yTDkh9c.gif[/img]

Additional quality of life features added include a crafting recipe tracker. Inside the workbench or your crafting tab in the journal, you can now pin a recipe at any quantity to pin it to your HUD like it’s a quest.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uRkL1yF.jpeg[/img]

You can also buy things from each shopkeeper when their store is closed. You won’t be able to speak to them directly to expand your house, but you can buy the basic goods from their shop.

[h1]🍃 Fast Like the Wind[/h1]
Yay, there’s new movement tech! Double jumping wasn’t enough, so now we have a [b]charged sword dash[/b] and[b] pickaxe bounce[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7HJUbig.gif[/img]

When you charge up your sword, you will dash the direction you’re facing. How far you go depends on how much you’ve charged. You can also dash mid-air, and if you time it just right, you can keep dashing and “fly”. I’m not too good at this myself, but I’m sure there’s some of you that will find this a walk in the park.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yDxR6xs.gif[/img]

The pickaxe bounce is when you’re mid-air, you can bounce off of anything by charging it any amount. The distance you bounce back depends on your initial velocity plus how much you’ve charged.

It makes the cutest little “bink” noise when you pull it off, so maybe you can have some fun just binking your way around town.

We also changed the charging: when you’re charging up any tool, it no longer locks you in place. You’ll move really slowly, but you’ll still be able to move.

[h1]✨ Closing Notes[/h1]
I hope it made sense why we had to take such a long chunk away from updates to work on this one! The way it was done and how many underlying systems needed to be completely gutted and redone was too many, so there was no way to “split it up”, so to speak. We’re really excited to add the new things in that we can have now that the foundation for Snacko is much cleaner and easier to work with. That’s something that will get more important as we add in more features and begin the work for multiplayer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KvVMFYI.gif[/img]

With all that said, I think the two of us need a day off to just lay down and do nothing.

As always, if you notice anything wrong with your save file or found a bug, please let us know! We’re always happy to help you fix any issues or rectify any errors in your save file.

You can reach us through [url=https://discord.gg/snackodev]Discord[/url] (just ping us, don’t be shy!) or [url=mailto:enralis@bluecurse.com]email[/url].

[h3]Thank you for reading my long-winded patch notes, and we really hope you enjoy this one!

Good night!!!! 🐾[/h3]

notes.title: 0.9.3_7945 🌲 Resource Spawning Options, 0.9.4 Update
notes.content:
Meowllo!
Small patch to add in "Resource Spawning" options into the gameplay tab in the settings.

Now, you can control whether or not the resources (trees, grass, flowers, bushes, rocks, etc.) will respawn in the town or the farm separately. You can toggle these at any time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/otZhehR.jpeg[/img]

Hopefully, this makes your dream island designs easier to work around!

As for how 0.9.4 is coming along, it's taking a while! There's a lot of things stuffed inside this quest update, so it's taking longer than expected.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QKV7CHP.gif[/img]

There will be new quest types and ways to pass your days on the island, so I hope you can understand the wait!

Meowllo!

Tiny patch updated early today to fix the [b]drop rate of saplings from trees[/b]. This should be especially noticeable in the Mushroom Forest, as they weren't dropping at all from Pine and Redwood.

We're currently working on 0.9.4, our next major update.
This one will be part one of three major updates to address NPC behaviours and overall worldbuilding.

[h2]🔖 0.9.4 will be targeting quests[/h2]
[b]If you've already played the main story quest, all of that progress will carry over to 0.9.4[/b] - the next update is mostly new content around the town, NPCs, and the currently unfinished skill system.

There's some changes to existing (non-story) quests/how some things are unlocked; so if you've already unlocked some of those things in 0.9.3, you'll get a mail message asking if you want to reset the relevant progression.

We're also going to [b]lift the restriction on one NPC per role[/b] in this upcoming update.
0.9.4 onwards, you will be encouraged to have multiple shopkeepers on your island to unlock all the items and shop stock.

Part of this update is also porting over part of our internal tooling (snackoEd) to be displayable publicly on the wiki, so players can peruse the quest tree.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DJ68QqD.jpeg[/img]

These quest changes have been very important to make sure we can continue scaling the game and adding in content that we want to implement going into and beyond 1.0, so thank you for being so patient!

[h2]⭐ Thank you for 100,000 wishlists![/h2]
We reached 100k wishlists a few days ago, and we just wanted to say thank you to everyone: players, future players, [strike]and people incessantly nagging their friends about Snacko[/strike].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IuD9esq.jpeg[/img]

At the risk of getting too sappy in a patch note(?), I'll just say both recursive and I deeply appreciate the feedback, posts, and messages we receive. It can get a little isolating sometimes working every day, but we're excited to wrap up 0.9.4 and get it out the door~

We also debuted a new trailer at the OTK Expo pre-show that focuses more on gameplay! We hope this trailer is better at communicating what there is in the game and how it plays.

I had a lot of fun making it, so I hope you enjoy 💝

notes.title: 0.9.3_7412 🌽 Better Item Drops & Resource Collecting Update
notes.content:
Meowllo~

Did you miss me?? We’ve been a bit busy, but here it is! The first part of making the game feel better by gutting all the old systems that just didn’t scale up to keep up with Snacko’s size is here: item drops!

[b]Obelisk, MIAOs, crafting...item collection is actually very central to Snacko’s gameplay loop,[/b] and we felt like it deserved a clear coat of polish to live up to the rest of the game’s newer features and level of thought put into it.

Nothing felt more frustrating than clearing all the rocks to get 2 measly Citrine Shards.

We outgrew the old way of handling resources and drops quickly, but recursive has gone through the diligent work of converting every single way items spawn into the world into the new system. It was a lot of work, let alone the work that went into creating the new drops and the backend tools to set it up.

[h3]Let’s all clap for recursive! Thank you![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rWIHV1u.jpeg[/img]

[h1]🌽 Item Drops[/h1]

Okay, so, the above screen snips make you feel like you’re an investment banker or something, right? At least, that’s how I feel using it.

[b]This let’s us control a couple of aspects:[/b]
[list]
[*] Which items drop at what % probabilities
[*] And when it does spawn, what is the % chance it drops X amount?
[*] And are there any conditions that can affect these drop rates?
[/list]
For example, Aquamarine Shards will now spawn a bit more frequently if you try to hunt for them in the Mushroom Forest on rainy days. Lapis Shards will be more common when you venture into the Desert Canyon after dark.

You also have a very rare chance of getting three shards in one rock!

This gives us more creativity to keep the resource gathering experience feeling rewarding and dynamic, while giving us better control over balancing for grinding in early game versus late game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n3DGC7v.jpeg[/img]

One example of this are the changes to Citrine and Emerald Shards. To help players get from the end of Grassy Plains to Desert Canyon, where the game first forces you to upgrade your tool, the spawn rate for Citrine and Emerald Shards are higher in the Spring.

This way, just by naturally playing and bonking the rocks in the farm, town, or Plains, players should have more than enough Citrine Shards to get into the Desert Canyon. Higher drop rates on the Citrine Shards means we can allow players to get that +1 Pickaxe and Axe easily without ruining the balance of giving the player too many gems, as Citrine effects are generally more geared towards the early game where money is still a tight resource.

Outside of just resource nodes, this means we were also able to add non-fish items to the fishing pool. On top of fish spawns should reflect their % chance better, you now also have a % chance of nabbing yourself a useful item while fishing in the Mines. You might get some garbage items, like a Boot, but you also have a shot at some handy materials, like a Fastener.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fvhJGxm.gif[/img]

Another part of the new item drop system meant we could modernize the farm tiles: the harvest animation has been sped up, and items now pop out. You also have a chance to get other items, like Plant Material.

Harvesting large plots of farms should now feel much faster and fluid.

As always, with these new balance changes, we’ll be keeping an eye out on everyone’s progress and feedback and adjust accordingly when something is over or undertuned!

[h1]✨ Misc.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added mirror to Mikan’s house so players can change their appearance early game
[*] Item drops in the mines no longer go through the walls and out of the mines
[*] Traditional Desk now allows you to place items on top
[*] Spinach can now be placed
[*] Farm tile rocks, etc. now share the same drops as the ones in the farm outside the tiles, making it consistent
[*] Fixed issue with gamepad routing in the shop screen
[*] The [url=https://snacko.wiki.gg/wiki/Snackopedia]wiki has had its data reimported[/url] to better match up with the new items and changed recipes
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x4ygk2T.jpeg[/img]

This patch had a ton of hidden work to bring our old systems out of technical debt and setting ourselves up for being to create more engaging systems to work around our planned quest and NPC improvements.

We hope that even though on the surface, item drop %s are not the most exciting, you’ll feel a positive difference in your gameplay.

Thank you very much for reading~
We’re always around in [url=https://discord.gg/snackodev]Discord[/url]. If you have any thoughts on the new drop rates, please let us know!

[h3]More updates are coming! See you very soon ( ･ω･)ﾉﾞ[/h3]

notes.title: 0.9.3_7294 🖌️ Placeable, Dyeable Cubes, Quarter Tile Snapping, & More
notes.content:
[h1]📦 Buildables Cubed[/h1]
We've added these boxes you can place. They have surface areas on top, and you can dye the caps and sides separately. To make your life easier, we've also added [b]quarter tile snapping[/b], which means you can now place the wall panels in a more useful manner without needing to free place.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tXVKvwS.jpeg[/img]

The grid has been changed to help convey this change.

The boxes should help eat away your growing Limestone collection. The crafting recipes can be bought at the Carpenter's under "Consumables". It'll appear in the same place as the wall panels.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZB55Pyj.jpeg[/img]

Speaking of the wall panels, the collision has been changed so you can place them closer along the wall or other blocks without it telling you it can't be placed!

To go with these new additions, we've switched around how the housing expansions feel to give it more of a progression curve. The West Wing, because it doesn't eventually lead to the upstairs or basement, is now the cheapest expansion, requiring much less materials in exchange for some Cocoa Beans.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DCGKqC3.jpeg[/img]

All expansions now have a Cocoa Bean price tag included in exchange for reducing the number of materials needed.

[h2]The changes for the expansion costs are as follows:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [strike]wood framing 40[/strike] removed
[*] drywall 20 → 10

[*] [strike]glass 10[/strike] removed
[*] added → cocoa beans 35,000
[/list]

[*] nails 50
[*] glass 10
[*] metal beam 10
[*] metal framing 10

[*] fastener 20 → 10
[*] metal framing 10
[*] concrete slab 40
[*] added → cocoa beans 50,000
[/list]

[h1]✨ Misc. [/h1]
[list]
[*] Something Fishy - caught fish will now immediately count toward quest progress
[*] New Game - Fixed bug where loading a game, quitting out, and starting a new game would retain barns/player house upgrades in a different save file
[*] Builder Kit - Fixed an issue where placing fences would prevent the player from dyeing objects until they re-entered the map
[*] Builder Kit - Fixed an issue where objects snapping to a flat surface weren't being placed exactly flat
[*] Softwood Table - Surface slightly smaller, making it easier to place chairs, etc. closer to it without snapping onto the surface
[*] You can now have more than one page of notes in your Planner
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TpYV72j.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Also, thank you very much for the 200+ reviews! We are getting closer to 500~[/h3]
Very excited to see what the builders in the community will do with these cubes 👀

We'd love to see your screenshots [url=https://discord.com/invite/snackodev]in our Discord[/url]! We have a forum channel dedicated to home, farm, town, and character customization!
